Let \(y=a\), \(x=a-\frac{\pi}{3}\), \(z=a+\frac{\pi}{3}\), and set \(t=\tan a\). Then

\[
\tan\left(a-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{t-\sqrt3}{1+\sqrt3t},\qquad
\tan\left(a+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{t+\sqrt3}{1-\sqrt3t}.
\]

So

\[
\tan x\tan y+\tan y\tan z+\tan z\tan x
\]

becomes

\[
\frac{t(t-\sqrt3)}{1+\sqrt3t}
+\frac{t(t+\sqrt3)}{1-\sqrt3t}
+\frac{t^2-3}{1-3t^2}.
\]

Combining,

\[
\frac{8t^2}{1-3t^2}+\frac{t^2-3}{1-3t^2}
=\frac{9t^2-3}{1-3t^2}
=-3.
\]

\[
\boxed{-3}
\]
